summary: Add wrapper-kind rules for linux-gate and mail-redelivery-canaries to the evidence skip policy

schema.detail: No daemon claim or portable record change; two entries in a policy file read from the accepted base.

rules.detail: No required check, daemon rule or main landing change. The gate still decides only; no job consumes the decision.

compatibility.detail: Policy data only; existing observed rules are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Removing the two wrapper entries restores observed-only acceptance.
